purpose: Authorize a seventh future-only 32-image image-bound v3 E2 lineage using deterministic lower candidate-pattern ordering from the remaining rebuilt prescreen-v2 pool.

evidence.sixth_result: R0 had 86 delivered parent and 86 delivered audit outcomes; R1/R2 were explicit zero-request closures; collection closed at 27 selected and five confirmed quality rejections.
evidence.read_only_sampling_validation: The five rejections were confirmed quality findings rather than provider-delivery uncertainty; classifier-led answers conflicted with visible evidence/private truth, including one image/label life-stage mismatch.
evidence.pattern_observation: Across six closed rebuilt-pool collection lineages, accepted/total was P2 18/19, P3 8/11, P4 10/13, P5 5/6, P6 30/31. This is directional small-sample evidence, not a new quality contract.
evidence.remaining_pool: 128 candidates, 16 per fixed cell, after excluding twelve preceding source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identity.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Select four fresh identities per fixed cell by ascending frozen candidate pattern (P2 before P3/P4/P5/P6), then sample ID; exclude all twelve preceding source lineages under image/source/near-duplicate identities.

qualification: This future-only sampling arm does not relax the exact 32-row/four-per-cell requirement. Confirmed quality rejections remain terminal and SFT remains separately unauthorized.
